title: Kaun Katega Taarpati
tagline: Run a three-player Hinglish voice game show on a server that owns the clock.
description: Build a multiplayer voice game show where one Agora agent hosts three contestants at once. A custom LLM endpoint sits between Agora and the model so authoritative game state is injected on every turn and tool calls actually execute, with a real PSTN call as the human-escalation lifeline.
author: subinsk
